# cloudaxion_s3_endpoint (Data Source)

The S3-compatible endpoint fronting object storage.

Bucket lifecycle belongs to this provider; everything inside a bucket belongs to the S3 API. Point the `aws` provider at this endpoint for objects, ACLs, versioning, encryption and policies.

~> On an account without object storage provisioned this returns almost nothing (`{"url": "/"}` was observed), which is the signal to ask the vendor to enable it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudaxion_s3_endpoint" "this" {}

# Point the aws provider at CloudAxion for object-level operations.
provider "aws" {
  endpoints { s3 = data.cloudaxion_s3_endpoint.this.endpoint }

  skip_credentials_validation = true
  skip_region_validation      = true
  skip_requesting_account_id  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint host, when the API reports one.
- `region` (String) S3 region, when the API reports one.
- `url` (String) Raw URL field as returned by the API.
